text.body:
{umāsaṃhitā} ||
locanaivamumukṣūṇāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ kāśyāṃ śrotriya (* * * * * * * * *) dakṣyāmi hāmini |
tasyopadeśamantreṇa muktiṃ vindanti mānavāḥ | uccārya (* * * * * * * * * *) mānavaḥ ||
amṛte kathayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam | avanti viṣaye kaścit brāhmaṇoveda (* * *) ||
śrutādhyayanasaṃpanno vidyādhara iti śrutaḥ | dhanināṃ śrotriyādīnāṃ svādhyāyavrata ṣālinām ||
kule (*) to viśeṣeṇa snānānuṣṭhānatatparaḥ | svayamasmai dvijagaṇairvedapāṭha paraśca saḥ ||
satkanyāṃ śrotriyakule pariṇīya śucismitām | mandasāseti vikhyātāṃ rāmāṃ sarvāṅgasundarīm ||
dīkṣito (*) n sadākāle juhotisma vidhānataḥ | evaṃ bhūto dvijavaro vedavādabahiṣkṛtaiḥ ||
kadācitkṛtasaṃvādastatra saṃkhyamarocata | vihāya vaidikāndharmāñchrutismṛtyurarīkṛtān ||
pāṣaṇḍaiḥ kṛtsaṃsargaḥ paradāraparāyaṇaḥ | veśyāpatirabhūnnityaṃ dravyatyāga kṛtādaraḥ ||
evaṃ dhaneṣu gacchatsu vibhajya bhrātaro dhanam | upekṣāñcakuraniśaṃ taṃ dvijaṃ vedadūṣakam ||
naṣṭeṣu dravyajāteṣu svadāranirato bhavat | sāpinī vurujā dagdhā pañcatvaṃ gamitā bhṛśam ||
(* * *) meti vijñāya cintayāno divāniśam | (* * * * * *) ñcintya hārāmeti rurodaha ||
hārāma rāma rāmeti hārāmeti manorame | iti śabdaṃ sa bahudhā kṛtvā sañcarati kṣitau ||
evaṃ kāle bahugate gatakalmaṣa pañjaraḥ | rāmasmaraṇa māhāmtyājjīvanmuktaśca cāra saḥ ||
evaṃ bhūtadvijavaraṃ kiṃ karāḥ kālacoditāḥ | sañcālya sarva prāṇāni kraṣṭumu (* * * * *) ||
(* *) prāṇeṣu saṃyojya prāṇastejasi yojitaḥ | kṛṣyamāṇe tejasitu ta (*) vavilayaṃ gataḥ ||
vidyādharo na dṛṣṭotra kvagato brāhmaṇādhamaḥ | iti śaktitacittāste mā gatesma parasparam ||
mārgitvā bahukālaṃ tu dūtāssvinna mukhā bhṛśam | rājñe nivedayāmāsurbrāhmaṇānadhanakriyām ||
bho bho preta pate yuṣmadgaṇakasya mukhācchrutam | vākyamākarṇya vegena gatāsma brāhmaṇāntikam ||
mahāntaṃ yatnamāsthāya brāhmaṇagrahaṇe sati | na tatra kiñcinna dṛṣṭaṃ nirāśā jīvite vayam ||
asmānnukaṃ svarājendra tavājñākāriṇo vayam | ityukta (* * * *) na citraguptamathāhvayat ||
yamaḥ(-)
citragupta tvayā sarvaṃ jñātaṃ sarvaja (* * *) | (* * * * * *) paṃ vai pāpināṃ dharmiṇāṃ tathā ||
adya vidyādharākhyasya brāhmaṇasya viceṣṭitam | ālocyā ca (* *) ṇaka pakṣapātavivarjitam ||
patrajālaṃ paraṃ mṛśya citro daṇḍadharaṃ vacaḥ | provāca nātha madvākyaṃ yathāvacchṛṇu sūryaja ||
janmaprabhṛti vipreṇa paradārābhimarśanam | vṛṣalīgamanaṃ caiva śūdrastrīgamanaṃ tathā ||
rajakīgamanaṃ caiva nartakī gamanaṃ tathā |
vaṃśakārāṅganāñcāpi sudhākārāṅganāṃ tathā ||
sūcikārasya lalanāṃ priyāṃ krākacikasya ca | vṛṣalīgamanaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ rāgavyaśādbhṛśam ||
ārūḍhapati tājjātā vardhakīvārayoṣitaḥ | rajasodarśanātpūrvamanūḍhā brāhmaṇāṅganā ||
ūḍhā ca samagotreṇa vṛṣalyaḥ kīrtitā budhaiḥ | yaḥ karotyekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsecanandvijaḥ ||
sabhaikṣa bhuñjapannityaṃ tribhirvarṣairviśudhyati | vṛṣalīgamanādvipraḥ kuṃbhīpākeṣu pacyate ||
paradārānnigamanātkālasūtreṣu pacyate | ayaṃ vidyādharo nāma pāpināmagrasaṃbhavaḥ ||
abhakṣya bhakṣaṇaṃ cakregrañca nānāṃ ca bhakṣaṇam | khaṭvāṅga kabakaṃ cāpi śugrukaṃ laśunaṃ tathā ||
niṣpāvabhakṣaṇaṃ cāpi vyāghra parṇasya bhakṣaṇam | upotakībhakṣaṇaṃ ca maurvā bhakṣaṇamādarāt ||
evamādīni pāpāni kṛtavāñchraddhayā saha | ekoddiṣṭaṃ navaśrāddhaṃ sa piṇḍapreta bhojanam ||
godānagrahaṇaṃ cāpi kṛtavānviprapātakī | vedamuccārya vādena dānagrahaṇa tatparaḥ ||
yatīnāṃ nindakaścāyaṃ mahatāṃ dūṣakastathā |
evamādīni pāpāni nityamācarate mudhā ||
tasmādvidehanirvāṇa padavīṃ nārhate dvijaḥ | evamuktena citreṇa kālo daṇḍadharoruṣa ||
daṇḍamudrāṃ ca saṃgṛhya vedhasontikamabhyagāt | satyalokaṃ gato rājā pretānāṃ kāryasādhakaḥ ||
praṇamya satyalokasthaṃ caturānanamastuvat | jaya vāṇīśa lokānāṃ sṛṣṭikarma viśārada ||
caturmukhadayāsindho vedavedya jaganmaya | sṛṣṭisthityanta karaṇe brahmaviṣṇvīśanāmaka ||
vijñāpanaṃ śṛṇuṣvādya dāsasya tava māriṣa |
evaṃ stuto daṇḍadhareṇa devo vāṇīśvarī vedasamūhayoniḥ | provāca kālaṃ paramāsanasthaḥ saṃstūyamāno'psarasāṃ samūhaiḥ ||
[ityumā saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyodhyāyaḥ] ||
|| [atha tṛtīyodhyāyaḥ] ||
umā(-)
sraṭhurantikamāsādya kiṃ kṛtaṃ ravisūnunā | vadasva kṛpayā mahyaṃ yadyadguhyaṃ maheśvara ||
īśvaraḥ(-)
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi viprasya caritaṃ mahat | yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate narakādapi ||
vidyādharākhyo vipraṣū sāyujyaṃ muktimabhyagāt |
brahmā(-)
dharmarāja pravakṣyāmi viprasya caritaṃ mahat ||
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhaviṣyati | ayaṃ brāhmaṇadāyodo rāmanāma sadā smaran ||
sahasranāma sadṛśaṃ rāmanāma varānane | koṭiyajñasamaṃ rāmacandro bhadretyayaṃ manuḥ ||
namontaśrutinā prokto vedānteṣu yathā kramam | rāmāya rāmacandrāya rāmabhadrāya vā manum ||
yāvajjīvañjapanmartyo jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ | tasmāt kauśikagotroyaṃ jajāpa paramaṃ manum ||
citraguptaḥ(-)
anena sarvapāpāni buddhipūrvakṛtāni ca | buddhi pūrvagate pāpe prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||
paradāra paradravya parānna grahaṇe rataḥ | vedavādatriṣeṇaiva gṛhītaṃ dhanasañcayam ||
gavāṃ pratigrahaṃ kṛtvā vikrayaṃ kṛtavānayam | durbhojanavidhau sakto duṣprati grahaṇe rataḥ ||
ajasraṃ viṣayāsaktaśśaucācārabahiṣkṛtaḥ |
brahmā(-)
rā śabdoccāraṇe jāte vaktrātpāpasya nirgamaḥ | makāra smaraṇe jāte bhasmabhāvaṃ vrajanti te ||
brahmahatyā sahasrāṇi svarṇasteyaśatāni ca | gurudāraśataṃ cāpi surāpānaśataṃ tathā ||
tatsaṃyogiśataṃ cāpi mucyate rāmadarśanāt | aupāsanāgnirahitāḥ pañcayajña parāṅmukhāḥ ||
sandhyāvandanahīnāśca śuddhā rāmasya kīrtanāt | abhakṣyabhakṣaṇāsaktā vṛṣalīgamane ratāḥ ||
uccārya satataṃ rāmaśabdaṃ muktā na saṃśayaḥ | gacchantiṣṭhansvapannṛtyan bhuñjānovāpi mānasaḥ ||
mucyate raghunāthasya nāmnāṃ kīrtano dvijaḥ |
bhojanādau smaranmantraṃ pratigrāsaṃ yathāruci | uccārya rāmavijayaṃ mucyate kṣatriyohaṃsaḥ ||
raghunāthasya nāmāni yo gṛhṇāti naro bhuvi | vimukta sarvapāpassa viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
rāmāyaṇasya ślokyaṃ vā pādaṃ vā padameva vā | bhuktyanteṣu prayuñjāno brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||
rāmāyaṇa kathāmeva ye bhṛṇvanti narottamāḥ | vidhūtapāpāste yānti brahmalokaṃ sanātanam ||
ye śṛṇvanti kathāṃ martyā rāghavendra jayārthitām | pādaṃ vā sargamekaṃ vā kāṇḍamekamathāpi vā ||
aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ vindanti mānavāḥ | caturviṃśatsahasrāṇāṃ ślokānāmuktavā nṛṣiḥ ||
tathā sargaśatānpañca ṣaṭkāṇḍāni tathottaram | kṛtsnaṃ rāmāyaṇaṃ yo vā śṛṇoti śrāvayeta vā ||
sarvabandhavinirmukto brahmabhūyāya kalpate | aputro labhate putraṃ kanyā satpatimāpnuyāt ||
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ vittārthī dhanavānbhavet | striyo rajasvalā śrutvā putrān sūyuranuttamān ||
śrutvā rāmāyaṇamidaṃ bandhyā putramavāpnuyāt | kaṭuṃbasya ca vṛddhissyāddhanadhānya samṛddhitā ||
mitrāṇāṃ caiva vṛddhissyāt putrāṇāṃ ca tathā bhavet | ānukūlyaṃ kalatreṣu śravaṇādeva jāyate ||
mahādāna pratigrahaṃ mahāpāpaharaṃ bhavet | caturviṃśati vārāṇāmādṛtyā niyameva ca ||
ṣaḍabdakṛcchre yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ setudarśane | tīrthācala prekṣaṇe ca tatpuṇyaṃ śravaṇādbhavet ||
jyotiṣṭomādi yajñānāṃ keṣāñcidadhikāritā | śrīmadrāmāyaṇe kāvye sarveṣāmadhikāritā ||
arthitvādiviśiṣṭasya karmaṇyadhikṛtirmatā | nityādi sādhanopāyo brahmajñāne yathā bhavet ||
tadvatsādhanasāpekṣā nāsti rāmāyaṇaśrutau | śrutvā rāmāyaṇaṃ kāvyaṃ muktibhāgjāyate narā ||
gāyatrī vedamātṛtvādyathā śreṣṭhatamā matā | tadvadrāmāyaṇākhyānaṃ caturviṃśati varṇakam ||
dharmamarthañca kāmañca gāyatrī japato labhet | mokṣañca śravaṇādeva vindanti manujā bhuvi ||
saṃsāratāpayuktānāṃ jantūnāṃ hatacetasām | śrīmadrāmāyaṇākhyānapīyūṣaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavet ||
durānna dagdhajihvānāṃ durdānahatacetasām | dussaṅgahatacittānāṃ kalipāśāvapāśinām ||
devapūjāvihīnānāṃ śrautasmārtā pavarjinām | pitṛpūjāvihīnānāṃ viyuktāgnyarcināmapi ||
śrīmadrāmāyaṇakathā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī | śrīmadrāmāyaṇaṃ martyā ye śṛṇvanti mahītale ||
sarvapāpa vinirmuktā viṣṇumandira gāminīḥ | iti daṇḍadhara prakhyānuktavāṃścaturānanaḥ ||
śrutvā dharmo viśvasṛjoktavākyaṃ nivartya lokāccaturānanasya | bhṛtyairvṛtassaṃyaminīti saṃjñāṃ purīṃ gato viśvasṛjaṃ praṇamya ||
[ityumā saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyodhyāyaḥ] ||
|| [atha caturthodhyāyaḥ] ||
umā(-)
bhūyo'pi śrotumicchāmi raghunāthasya vaibhavam | laṅkāyāṃ rāvaṇaṃ hatvā pratiṣṭhāpya vibhīṣaṇam ||
kiṃ kṛtaṃ raghunāthena tatsarvaṃ vaktumarhasi |
śivaḥ(-)
hatvā daśagrīva mathāni madhye āruhya yānammanasā visṛṣṭam | dhātrā trikūṭācalasanniviṣṭe laṅkāpure rāvaṇa sodarañca ||
kṛtvā rājānamavyagraṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmo maheśvaram | ṛkṣagopucchaharibhiḥ rakṣobhiḥ parivāritaḥ ||
liṅgaṃ ratnamayaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya maheśituḥ | brahmahatyāpanodārthaṃ lokānugrahakāmyayā ||
dṛṣṭvā ratnamayaṃ liṅgaṃ rāmanātheti viśrutam | vidhūta sarvapāpāste śivaloke mahīyate ||
pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṅgaṃ brahmahatyāpanuttaye | setumadhye sthitaṃ liṅgaṃ cāmīkara viniṣṭhitam ||
rāmanātheti vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpāpahārakam | dṛṣṭvā māheśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ mahārajatanirmitam ||
avidyāpāśamuktāste sāyujyapadagāminaḥ | vārdheruttarakūle ca saikataṃ liṅgamuttamam ||
sthāpya lokasya rakṣāyai mahāpātakaśāntaye | rāmeṇa sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ gandhamādanamastake ||
brahmahatyādi pāpebhyo dṛṣṭvā mucyeta mānavaḥ | kṛcchraṃ vā dvādaśābdaṃ vā brahmahatyā nivṛttaye ||
hayamedhakraturvāpi rāmasetoḥ pradarśanam | munibhirveda tatvajñaissthitaṃ lokasya guptaye ||
ṣaṣṭikṛcchrasamaṃ prāhuśśrīśailasyāvalokanam | tadvadrāmeśvarākhyasya darśanānmunayoviduḥ ||
bhaktvā setuṃ triḥ prakāraṃ tūṇīrāgreṇa rāghavaḥ | puṣpakāśe samāruhya jagāma diśamuttarām ||
śrītīrtha śikharīndraśya śikhare samupasthite | madhyāhna samaye rāmaḥ puṣpakādavaruhya ca ||
ākāśagaṅgāmāvāhya pūjāṃśaṃbhoścakāra ha | gatvā tīrthagiriṃ martyaḥ snātvā mandākinī jale ||
dṛṣṭvā tīrthagirīśasya liṅgaṃ mukto bhaviṣyati | phanarvimānamāruhya kiṣkindhāgirigaṃbare ||
puṣpakādavaruhyāśu snātvā nadyāṃ śubhodake | virūpākṣābhidhānaṃ ca māṃ pūjayāmāsa śāstrataḥ ||
kirāto bahukālaṃ māṃ muktyarthaṃ samapūjayat | savālirvānarendro bhūddhatvā vālinamāhave ||
rāmākhyena mayā tasmai muktirdattā śarāgninā | bharadvājāśramaṃ gatvā rāmassatyaparākramaḥ ||
bharatasya sakāśāya preṣayāmāsa mārutim | śrutvā hanūmato vākyaṃ bharatassatya vikramaḥ ||
paurairanugato dūraṃ rāmaṃ pratyudyayau purāt | rāmo'pi bhrātṛbhissārdhamabhiṣikto varāsane ||
nyāyena kārayāmāsa rājyasya paripālanam | śataṃ kratūnāmājahne vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ ||
vājapeya śatairiṣṭvā tathā bahusuvarṇakaiḥ | pratyahaṃ daśasāhasraṃ gavāṃ dānamakalpayat ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ viśiṣṭhānāṃ pratyahaṃ koṭi saṃkhyakam | suvarṇamadadādrāmo brahmārpaṇadhiyādarāt ||
sṛṣṭapuṣṭajanapadā brāhmaṇā veda pālinaḥ | rājāno bahuvīryāḍhyo vaiśyābahudhanādhipāḥ ||
śūdrā dānaparāścāsan rāme rājani bhūtale |
evaṃ sthito rāghavāṇāṃ variṣṭho
divārātraṃ brahmahatyākulobhūt | tasyonmādaṃ cintayāno dante mitrāvaruṇaṃ dudbhavaṃ prāhavākyam ||
rāmaḥ(-)
vīrahasyāpanodārthaṃ vadopāyaṃ guro mama |
vasiṣṭhaḥ(-)
śṛṇu rāghava rājendra sarvapāpāpanodakam | purā kolāhalo nāma vṛṣalaḥ kālacoditaḥ ||
khaḍgena pitaraṃ hatvā gṛhītvā mātaraṃ yayau | vedāraṇyaṃ samāsādya saraṃsītkāmamohitaḥ ||
sopi vedavaneśasya prabhāvātkṣemṛṇauravāt | vedānta jñānamāsādya śivānugraha hetutaḥ ||
vimuktiṃ paramāṃ prāpta iti śāstreṣu śuśrumaḥ | tvantu vedavanaṃ gatvā samārādhya vṛṣākapim ||
natvā guruṃ śamīmūle mucyateṃ ho gaṇādbhavān | ityuktorundhatī bhartrā rāmo bhrātṛgaṇaissaha ||
mātṛbhissītayā sārdhaṃ balena mahatāvṛtaḥ | vedāraṇyaṃ samuddiśya yayau puṣpavimānataḥ ||
vasiṣṭho vāmadevaśca jābālirathakāśyapaḥ | bharadvājo gautamaśca ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ ||
śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyaissahitā rāmasya tvanuyāyinaḥ | dhṛṣṭirjayanto vijayassiddhārthohyartha sādhakaḥ ||
aśoko mantrapā (*) śca sumantraśca yayau drutam | ṛkṣavānaragopucchaissaṃyuto vānarādhipaḥ ||
rāmapādāvalokārthaṃ gato vedavanaṃ priye | vibhīṣaṇassamākarṇya khervaṃśavivardhanam ||
āgataṃ setu śirasi tūrṇamabhyarṇamabhyagāt | rāma indīvaraśyāmaḥ puṣpakādavaruhya ca ||
niyamena samāgatya brahmatīrthe vagāhya ca | vedatīrthe tatassnātvā snātvā tu maṇi karṇikām ||
liṅgaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ dṛṣṭvā vimukto vīraghātakāt | snātvā tīrthavare tatra santarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ||
brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ datvā mahādānānyaśeṣataḥ | ratnaṃ maṇiṃ suvarṇaṃ ca gajadānāni bhūriśaḥ ||
rāmacandrapurannāma bahugrāmamakalpayat | svanāmnā sthāpayāmāsa liṅgaṃ sarvārtha siddhidam ||
sakṛttaddarśanādeva mucyate sarvapātakāt | mahāpātaka yukto vā yukto vā kṣudrapātakaiḥ ||
śrīrāmaliṅgamāsādya jīvanmukto bhaviṣyati | lakṣmaṇassthāpayāmāsa liṅgaṃ pāpāpanuttaye ||
hanumānapi tatraiva śāmbhavaṃ liṅgamuttamam | svanāmnā sthāpya saṃpūjya vimuktaḥ pātakaughataḥ ||
sahyajāyāstaṭe ramye grāmaṃ bahuguṇānvitam | kṛtvā vāyūdbhavaḥ pāpādvimukto rakṣasāṃ vadhāt ||
pañcāśataṃ mahāliṅgaṃ kāverī puṇyarodhasi | tatra tatra pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayāmāsa rāghavaḥ ||
paṃpānadyāstaṭe vāpi subrahmaṇya nadī taṭe | tathā kṣuranadītīre peṇṇātīre tathaiva ca ||
godāvaryāstaṭe ramye revānadyāstaṭeṣu ca | tatra tatra pratiṣṭhāpya puṇyadeśeṣu rāghavaḥ ||
nyāyena kṛtavānrāmo rājyasya paripālanam ||
|| [ityumāsaṃhitāyāṃ caturthodhyāyaḥ] ||
|| [atha pañcamodhyāyaḥ] ||
īśvaraḥ(-)
śṛṇu vakṣyāmi he devi bālakāṇḍa kathāphalam | tapassvādhyāyanirataṃ tapasvī vāgvidāṃ varam ||
nāradaṃ paripapraccha vālmīkirmunipuṅgavam | idaṃ śrutvā naro bhaktyā tapassiddhimavāpnuyāt ||
svādhyāyaniratānāṃ ca phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ | duranna bhakṣaṇānmuktaḥ pūto bhavati nityaśaḥ ||

nandīśvaraṃ samāhūya preṣayatkāryasādhane | nandī kuṭhāramādāya bhedayāmāsa parvatam ||

tacchaṃkaraśiro bhraṣṭaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ bhūmitale punaḥ | vyarecata tadā toyaṃ nirmalaṃ gatakalmaṣam ||
tatrarṣigaṇagandharvā vasudhātalavāsinaḥ | bhavāṅgapatitaṃ toyaṃ pavitramiti pavitramiti paspṛśuḥ ||
bhavāṅge patitaṃ yasmātkutrāpi salilaṃ narāḥ |
dhṛtvā vidhūtapāpāste śivamandiragāminaḥ | dhṛtvā śivasya salilamabhiṣecana saṃbhavam ||
mucyante saṃsrati bhayāt brāhmaṇādyāḥ pibantu vā | gaṅgā saṃplāvayāmāsa yajñavāṭammahātmanaḥ ||
tasyāvalepanaṃ jñātvā kruddho jahnustu rāghava | apivattajjalaṃ sarvaṃ gaṅgāyāḥ paramādbhutam ||
hṛdi dhyāyanmahādevaṃ śivānugraha vaibhavāt | apivaccodakaṃ vārdheryathā vai kuṃbhasaṃbhavaḥ ||
gaṅgāmupanayantisma duhi tṛtve mahātmanaḥ | śivānugraha vai śiṣṭayācchrotrābhyāmasṛjatpunaḥ ||
tasyāvalepanam |
pitāmahānbhasmakṛtānapaśyaddīnacetanaḥ ||
atha tadbhasmanāṃ rāśiṃ gaṅgāpatanamuttamam | plāvayatpūtapāpmānassvargaṃ prāptā raghūttama ||
brahmāṇḍastāḍitaḥ pūrvaṃ hariṇā chidratāṃ gataḥ | brahmāṇḍaṃ bāhyato yena daśapāśabhṛtāpratam ||
tena chidreṇa tattoyaṃ viveśāṇḍaṃ varānane | yathā kathaṃ cidvai dṛṣṭvā bhaktitaścinmayaḥ sakṛt ||
gaṅgā tārayate nṝṇāṃ kulānāṃ śatamaṃbhasā | yaistu spṛṣṭā vaśiṣṭā ca gaṅgā bhaktyā sa kṛnna ||
kulānāntu sahasrantu teṣāṃ dhārayate bhayāt | pītā madhudruvā martyairyairgaṅgā bhaktitassakṛt ||
teṣāṃ kulānāmayutaṃ bhavāttārayate dhruvam | yaiḥ puṇya vāhinī gaṅgā sakṛdbhaktyā vagāhitā ||
teṣāṃ kulānāṃ lakṣantu bhavāttārayate śivā | yairdinaṃ sevitā gaṅgā bhaktyā puṇyajanairnaraiḥ ||
kulānāṃ daśalakṣantu teṣāṃ dhārayate bhavāt | gaṇge gaṅgeti gaṅgeti yaistrisandhyamudīritā ||
dūrastheścāpi tatpāpaṃ hanti janmatrayārjitam | sahasrayojanastho'pi trisandhyaṃ yassamāhitaḥ ||
gaṅge gaṅgeti ca brūyātsagacchetparamāṃ gatim | yojanānāṃ sahasreṣu gaṅgāṃ smarati yo naraḥ ||
api duṣkṛta karmāsau labhate paramāṃ gatim | gaṅgāyāṃ vaiṣṇave śaktau parabrahmavibhāvanām ||
na kurvanti ca ye martyā na taistu sahasaṃ vaset | nadīnāmavamantavyaṃ kadācidapi suvrate ||
gaṅgārayaṃ samākarṇya sāgarotha bhagīratham | prārthayāmāsa gaṅgāyāḥ pravāho vegavattaraḥ ||
soduṃ na śakyate trāhi gādho me bhavitā prabho | ityuktavantaṃ vārīśaṃ mābhīrityavadannṛpaḥ ||
asmatkulīnaissaṃvṛddho mayā kiṃ dūyase'dhunā | bhagīratho'pi rājarṣiḥ provāca tanayānnijām ||
putrī vākyaṃ samākarṇya kurukāryamanantaram | tvatpūrva prabhavaiḥ pūrvaṃ khānitaḥ prapitāmahaiḥ ||
pūrvairācarito dharmo na hantavyonvayodbhavaiḥ | ityuktā svardhunī pitrā kariṣye vacanantava ||
sahasradhā nadī bhūtvā tadā sāgaramabhyagāt | sa gatvā sāgaraṃ rājā ityupakramya śṛṇvatām ||
pitarassvargamāyānti nirayasthā anūdakāḥ | gaṅgāvatāramārabhya śrāvayecchrāddhabhojane ||
pitarastena tṛptāssyuryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam | trīn pathaḥ pāvayantīti tatastripathagā smṛtā ||
santāraṃ kathayāmāsā sarṣi saṃghassa rāghavaḥ | bhavāmbudhau nimagnānāṃ vīkṣaṇāttārakasvayam ||
rāmassuranadīṃ nāvā tārayatkā vicitratā | śrutvā pīyūṣamathanaṃ surāsuravinirmitam ||
auṣadhasvīkṛtiṃ kuryāttasya rogo vinaśyati | dhanvantariṃ garutmantaṃ maṇirājaṃ ca kaustubham ||
acyutañcāmṛtaṃ caiva smaredauṣadhakarmaṇi | uccaiśravā hariśreṣṭho maṇiratnaṃ ca kaustubham ||
udatiṣṭhannara śreṣṭha tathaivāmṛtamuttamam | aditerindrasaṃvādaṃ śrutvā tu marutāñjanim ||
asapatno mahīṃ bhuṅkte rājā śakro yathā divam | ahalyāmṛtukāle tu indreṇa kṛtasaṅgamām ||
ātmānaṃ māṃ ca deveśaṃ sarvadā rakṣamānada | ityādi priyavārtāṃ ca śakrasya gamanaṃ tathā ||
gautamasya narendrasya sadṛśākṛtiśobhane | śāpamindre ca bhāryāyā muninākṛtamañjasā ||
śrutvā mucyeta manujo nārī vā vyabhicāriṇī | mucyate sarvadoṣebhyo vyabhicārakṛtānnijāt ||
imau kumārau bhadraṃ te deva tulyaparākramau | jaga sihmagatīvīrau śārdūlāviva rūpiṇau ||
ityādi kṛtajālantu janakena subhāṣitam | viśvāmitra(-)ṛṣerbhaktyā puṣkalaṃ brahmamāpnuyāt ||
brahmahāmucyate pāpānmitrahā mucyate tataḥ | sāvitrī patitaścāpi vrātyā nācāradūṣitaḥ ||
tapasāṃ siddhimākarṇya viśvāmitrasya mānavaḥ | tapaścaraṇi saṃsiddhiṃ labhante mānavā cirāt ||
viśvāmitro mahātejāḥ pālayāmāsa medinīm | ityādi śravaṇādeva paṭhanādvijitendriyaḥ ||
kāmadhenu prasādā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt | durannabhakṣaṇā tā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||
huṃkāreṇaiva tānsarvānnirdadāha mahānṛṣiḥ | tasmādvipreṣu nāvajñā kāryā bhūtimihechatā ||
avajñātā dahantyete huṃkṛtyā vīkṣaṇena ca | kena cittathakālena devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ ||
ityādi granthajālena śivo dhyeyaśśivaṃkaraḥ | ityukta(-)ṛṣiṇā devo mahādevo mamepsitam ||
evamastviti deveśastaṃ varaṃ vṛṇuyādvaram | brahmāstragrasanaṃ śrutvā daṇḍāgrerundhatī pateḥ ||
brāhmaṇyaṃ vardhate tasya pūrvapakṣe śaśī yathā | anyāṃ gatiṃ gamiśyāmi svasti vostu tapodhanāḥ ||
śepuḥ paramasaṃkruddhāścaṇḍālatvaṃ gamiṣyasi | tasmādguruṣu nāvajñā kāryā bhūtimihecchatā ||
ruṣṭe śive gurustrātā gurau ruṣṭe na kopi hi | ikṣvāko svāgataṃ vatsa jānāmi tvāṃ sudhārmikam ||
śaraṇaṃ te bhaviṣyāmi mā bhaiṣī raghupuṅgava | pūrvameva varo datto mayā tubhyammahīpate ||
tadidaṃ sādhayiṣyāmi durdaśāyāmihādhunā | triṃśakoḥ kārayāmāsa vedāraṇye mahākratum ||
svarlokātpatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā triśaṅkuṃ kopadūṣitam | sṛjadakṣiṇamārgasthān saptarṣī na parānpunaḥ ||
nakṣatra mālāmaparāmasṛjatkrodhamūrchitaḥ | anyamindraṃ kariṣyāmi loko vāsyādanindrakaḥ ||
iti saṃkalpamakaronmadanugraha vaibhavāt |
umā(-)
bhaṇyatāṃ devadeveśa viśvāmitrāya dhīmate | dattaṃ sraṣṭramaparaṃ vinā tu caturānanam ||
maheśvaraḥ(-)
śrūyatāṃ devi vakṣyāmi punassvargasya kāraṇam | padmayoniṃ purā labdhvā sraṣṭutvaṃ matsakāśataḥ ||
lokānasṛkṣatsaṃkalpāt vīkṣaṇātpūrvahetutaḥ | ahameva paro loke padārthāni pṛthak pṛthak ||
sṛṣṭā ṛkṣāṇi gagane vaiśvānarapathādbahiḥ | avāk śirāstriśaṅkuśca tiṣṭhatvamara sannibhaḥ ||
umā(-)
vedestra tiṣu sarvatra brāhmaṇasyaiva yājanam | śiṣṭāsre varṇikā yājyā kathametena kāritam ||
maheśvaraḥ(-)
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi viśvāmitrastu saṃbhavam |
prajāpatisutaśśrīmānkuśonāma mahīpatiḥ ||
kuśasya putro balavānkuśanābhassudhārmikaḥ | kuśanābhasutaśśrīmāngādhirityeva viśrutaḥ ||
anapatyo gādhirājā nāmnā satyavatīṃ sutām | ṛcīka(-)ṛṣaye prādātkulasya trāṇakāraṇāt ||
so'pi putrārtha mamalāmiṣṭimārabdhavānṛṣiḥ | pātre nidhāya haviṣāṃ dvitayaṃ putrasaṃbhavam ||
kṛpīḍayonā vajuhodekaṃ putrasya saṃpade | datvā śeṣaṃ yajñapatnyaṃ anyadādātu maicchata ||
naṣṭhaṃ haviṣamālokya ṛṣiḥ patnīmavaikṣata | sāpi bhartuḥ pade gṛhya praṇanāma bhayāturā ||
strībudhyā sāhasamidaṃ kṛtamekāhaṭhātprabho | anapatyā hi me mātā tasyāpatyasya kāraṇāt ||
dattaṃ mayā sāhasena mantritaṃ haviruttamam | prasīda mahyaṃ dayayā bhaktāṃ rakṣasva matprabho ||
ityevaṃ prārthitaḥ patnyā kauśikyā bhagavānṛṣiḥ | kṛpāṃ cakāra dayayā so'pi brāhmaṇatāṃ vrajet ||
ityābhāṣya priyāṃ vipraḥ kratu śeṣaṃ samāpayat |
umā(-)
etādṛśaguṇopeta(-)ṛṣiḥ kauśikanandanaḥ |
ayājya yājane śraddhamakarottadvadasvame |
maheśvaraḥ(-)
satriśaṅkuḥ pūrvamabhūddurnayaṃ kalpamāsthitaḥ | pituścāparitoṣeṇa gurordogdhrīvadhena ca ||
apreṣito payogācca trividhosya vyatikramaḥ | evaṃ trīṇyasya śākuni tāni dṛṣṭvā maharṣayaḥ ||
prayuñjate śabdajālaṃ triśaṅkupadavācakam | yauvasthassatīṃ bhāryāṃ na vrajedyadi mānavaḥ ||
sa jīvanneva caṇḍālo narmadānnaiva bhuktavān | brāhmaṇyāṃ yo naro mauḍhyādbrāhmaṇīṃ kāmamohitaḥ ||
na parigrahet
yadi gṛhṇīta mūḍhātmā caṇḍālatvaṃ sa gacchati |
gatvā tu mātaraṃ martyassnuṣāṃ bhrāptṛ(?)traṃganāṃ tathā | putrīṃ vā bhaginīṃ mauḍhyādvrajedyaḥ kāmamohitaḥ ||
sajīvanneva caṇḍālamāśu gacchati sānvayaḥ |
umā(-)
idānīṃ guruṇā śaptaḥ kathaṃ yājyo bhava dṛṣe | caṇḍāla prokṣitaṃ duṣṭaṃ smṛtaṃ karmāntarālake ||
tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ prāhurmunayastatvacintakāḥ |
maheśvaraḥ(-)
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi triśaṃkoryajanaṃ prati | purā triśaṅkurguruṇā pitṛśokācca tāpitaḥ ||
tasya śāpāpanodārthamṛṣibhissūkṣmadarśibhiḥ | triṣaḍvāraṃ ṣaḍabdākhyaṃ kṛcchraṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ||
tatassnānaṃ samādāya śivanirṇejane jale | śivakṣetre śivaṃ pūjya tīrtheṣu ca nimajya ca ||
śuddhadehe mahīpāle hyayajatkṛtasattamaiḥ | abālako devaloko na kṣatraḥ grāma yājakaḥ ||
karmacaṇḍālakā hyete mahāpātakapañcamāḥ | gurudrohavaśājjātā karmacaṇḍālatā mayam ||
tasmātkṛcchrādi caraṇācchuddhirnānyasya kasya cit | tadvatpūtaṃ kārayitvā yajñaṃ kauśikanandanaḥ ||
triṃśakoḥ kārayāmāsa śāstra dṛṣṭena vartmanā | anāgatāndi viṣadānprekṣya krodhānalojjvalaḥ ||
svarlokaṃ prāpayāmāsa svakīya tapasaḥ phalāt |
umā(-)
svarlokātpatanaḥ kasmātprāyaścittagatainasaḥ ||
tanmamācakṣva deveśa yamāntaka purāntaka |
maheśvaraḥ(-)
prāyacitte kṛte puṃsāmenasāṃ nāśayiṣyate |
bhūlokaśuddhirnāstyeva śuddhissyātpāralaukikī | tasmāttaddeha yuktatvātpātayanti sma bhūtale ||
umā(-)
aśuddho yadi bhūpālastasminprema kathaṃ muneḥ | iti pṛṣṭhaḥ kathā madhye provāca kṛpayā śivaḥ ||
tapaḥ kartumanā devi viśvāmitra(-)ṛṣiḥ purā | bhāryāṃ triśaṅkornikaṭe nidhāya tapase gataḥ ||
siddhe tapasi rājānaṃ prītobhūdgādhinandanaḥ | varandadāmi gṛhṇīṣva bhāryābharaṇatoṣitaḥ ||
samākarṇya ṛṣervākyaṃ rājā provāca gādhijam | māstvidānīṃ paraguro āpatkāle tathākuru ||
tasaṃ prārthito rājñā idānīṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ | dayāṃ cakāra rājānaṃ caṇḍālākārarūpiṇam ||
umā(-)
ye dūṣayantya dūṣyaṃ māntapa ugraṃ samāsthitam | bhasmībhūtā durātmāno bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||
adyate kālapāśena gatā vaivasvatakṣayam | ityā(di) vākyanikaraṃ proktvā sadasikopanaḥ ||
virarāma mahātejā ṛṣimadhye mahāmuniḥ | ityādivākyakathanādbrahmahatyā ṛṣeḥ katham ||
nāsītkathaṃ tatra bhavānuttaraṃ vaktumarhati |
maheśvaraḥ(-)
purā kadācidyajñāte mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhavaḥ | raghoḥ putraṃ durādharṣaṃ saudā samaśapadbhṛśam ||
kalmāṣa pādassaṃśaptaḥ pravṛddhaḥ puruṣādakaḥ | abhavadbhūpatitve'pi madhyāhne narabhojanaḥ ||
viśvāmitra(-)ṛṣiḥ kālye kālena tvā puraṃ vrajet | tamasmaranmahātejāssaudāsaṃ puruṣādakaḥ ||
āgatasmaraṇādeva nikaṭaṃ gādhinandanaḥ | taṃ me (* * * * *) ghnaṃ vāsiṣṭhānhantumudyatam ||
bhakṣitāstena rājñāte bhasmībhāvaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ | ambarīṣa iti khyāto yaṣṭuṃ samupacakrame ||
etatsargaṃ sadā śṛṇvan brahmahā mucyateṃhasaḥ | (* *) kasya kathāṃ śṛṇvan yovā kovā maheśvarī ||
putravikrayajāddoṣāttathā putrārpaṇāyataḥ | vimuktañcarā loke śrīrāmasya prasādataḥ ||
ṛgvedasiddhedve gādhe tṛtīyāṣṭakacoditaḥ | prayuñjāno naro nityaṃ bhavābaṃdhādvimucyate ||
ṛṇabandhādvimuktāsyurvyādhibandhāttathaiva ca | tathaiva śṛṅkhalābandhānmucyate śravaṇādiha ||
viśvāmitro mahānbhūyastapastepe mahāmanāḥ | tataḥ kālena mahatā menakā paramāpsarāḥ ||
tātparyavarṇakamidaṃ gāyatryāssarvakāmadam | śṛṇvatāṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param ||
ahorātrāpadeśena gatāssaṃvatsarā daśa | abbhakṣo vāyubhakṣo vā jīrṇaparṇāśano'pi vā ||
strīṇāṃ samakṣe vastavyaṃ na kadācinmaheśvari | varadānaṃ viśvayonestapaḥ phalacikīrṣayā ||
śṛṇvatāṃ viphalaṃ yānti pāpāni tridaśeśvari | brāhmaṇyaṃ yadi me prāptaṃ dīrghamāyustathā purā ||
umā(-)
aśraddhā brāhmaṇo vākye kiṃ kṛtaṃ gādhisūnunā |
maheśvaraḥ(-)
mayā yaṣṭhumupakrānte triśaṅkoryāgakarmaṇi | vāsiṣṭhādūṣayantisma kathaṃ sadasi devatāḥ ||
tānhantu preṣitaḥ pūrvaṃ kruddhaḥ kalmāṣapādakaḥ | bhakṣitāstena rājñā te bhasmībhāvaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ ||
tāndṛṣṭvā bhakṣitānrājñā mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhavaḥ | putraśokābhibhūtastu pralalāpa bhṛśārditaḥ ||
prajñāmavaṣṭabhya śanaiḥ pūrvavattapasi sthitaḥ |
sopīdānīmadūṣyammāmugre tapasi saṃsthitam ||
ityukto bhāratīnāthaḥ provācārundhatī patim | brahmarṣitvaṃ vadānena tapasā toṣito bhavān ||
brahmarṣistvaṃ na sandehassarvaṃ saṃpādyate tava | viśvāmitrastutiṃ śṛṇvanśatānandena bhāṣitām ||
puṣkalaṃ brāhmya māsādya brahmaloke mahīyate | dakṣayajñavadhe pūrvandhanurādāya vīryavān ||
vidhvaṃsya tridaśānroṣātsalīlamidamabravīt | prasādayanti deveśannamaste rudramanyave ||
he rudradhanuṣastubhyamuto ta iṣave namaḥ | bāhubhyānte nama iti stutibhiśśruti coditaiḥ ||
prasādito to mahādevaḥ prasādamakarochivaḥ | bhūtalādutthitā sā tu vyavardhata mamātmajā ||
bhūtalādutthitāṃ devīnnārāyaṇa kuṭuṃbinīm | rājāno bahuvīryāḍhyā vārayāmāsurādarāt ||
pratyākhyātā bhūpatayastṛṇata pravaṇachalāt | arundha mithulāṃ sarve vīrya sandehamāgatāḥ ||
tasmādviśiṣṭaṃ yadvastu na dhāryaṃ dhīmatā kvacit | dhṛte tu prāṇahānissyātsyamantaka maṇiryathā ||
yathā pīyūṣakhaṃ rakṣā yathā drupadajāsthitiḥ |
tasmācchreṣṭhaguṇopetaṃ na dhāryaṃ vastu mānavaiḥ ||
babhañja taddhanurmadhye naraśreṣṭho mahāyaśāḥ | gṛhīte raghunāthena mahādevaśarāsane ||
śaktistu vaiṣṇavaṃ prāpte tasmā bhagnā maheśituḥ | tasminnavasare pāśī vaiṣṇavaṃ dhanuruttamam ||
dattavānkosalendrasya kare prītipurassaram | taddhanurvaruṇābhyarṇe punaḥ pratyarpayacchive ||
rājñā vaṃśānukathanaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśanam | śrutvā godāna kathanaṃ godānaphalamāpnuyāt ||
prapāmadhyetyupakramya jānakyā maṅgalotsavam | śrutvā vivāhaṃ kurvīta patnī dīrghāyuṣī bhavet ||
daṃpatyossatataṃ prītirvardhate nāyake vayaḥ | tasmātkalyāṇasamaye śrotavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ||
godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ ca kanyādānaṃ tathaiva ca | ātmanaśśriyamanvicchan prayacchetsarvavarṇakaḥ ||
tasmādvivāhaṃ prekṣeta ātmanāśriyamicchubhiḥ | sarvotsave tu kalhāro madhūkastu svayaṃvare ||
sīmante garbhiṇī nārī yavāṅkuramayī bhavet | dhāryā tu pretakārye vai mālā naladanirmitā ||
sītāyai pradadau ratnaṃ kausalyā vārisaṃbhavam |
tayā bhūṣitagātrā sā śuśubhendīvare kṣaṇā ||
bhārgavaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ ca rājarājavimardanam | ityādiśravaṇātpuṃsāṃ brāhmantejobhivardhate ||
śitikaṇṭhasya viṣṇośca balābalaparīkṣayā | abhiprāyantu vijñāya devatānāṃ pitāmahaḥ ||
virodhañjanayāmāsa tayossatvavatāṃ varaḥ | adhikaṃ menire viṣṇuṃ devā ṛṣigaṇāstadā ||
umā(-)
tvatto viśiṣṭa bhāvastu viṣṇossaṃprati gaṇyate | kathametaddayāsindho kṛpayā vada suvratam ||
maheśvaraḥ(-)
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi viṣṇorādhikyatāṃ prati | purā kadāciddeveśi paramānandakānane ||
krīḍāsakte mayi tadā viśvametadanāyaka | upadrutaṃ sadā duṣṭairvedavādabahiṣkṛtaiḥ ||
svāhāsvadhā vaṣaṭkārarahite karmavarjitaiḥ | brahmaṇā jñātavṛttāntaḥ kāryaśeṣamacintayam ||
cakrapāṇiṃ samāhūya ratnasiṃhāsane śubhe | abhiṣicya varāndatvā praṇāmaṃ karavaṃ priye ||
sṛṣṭi sthiti vināśānāṃ kartṛtvamakuto bhayam |
sarvajñatādisiddhiṃ ca dattavānasmi viṣṇave | mattodhiko bhavānājau bhava viṣṇo kvacit kvacit ||
iti datvā varānpūrvaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ hariṃ purā | iti datvā varān pūrvaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ hariṃ purā ||
idaṃ jñātvā kaviḥ prāha menire dhipatiṃ priye | śarañca pratisaṃgṛhya hastātkra(?)ghu parākramaḥ ||
āropya dhanuṣī rāmassaśaraṃ sannikarṣaha |
umā(-)
nirvīryo jāmadagnyosau rāmo rāmamavaikṣata ||
ityuktaṃ ṛṣiṇā kāvye nirvīryatvaṃ ṛṣeḥ katham |
maheśvaraḥ(-)
jāmadagnyāvatāroyaṃ hare rāveśamātrakaḥ ||
pūrṇāvatāramālokya śaktissāṅkramitā bhavat | rātrau divākaraṃ tejo nihitaṃ havyavāhane ||
prātassūrya yathā gacchedvahnirahni yathāpuram | kausalyā ca sumitrā ca kaikeyī ca sumadhyamā ||
vadhūpratigrahe yuktā yāścānyā rājayoṣitaḥ | ityādi śravaṇātstrīṇāṃ snuṣābhūyaskaraṃ bhavet ||
snuṣāssyuḥ patimātṝṇāmiṣṭāḥ prītiṇu vallabhāḥ | kāṇḍāntaṃ śrāvayedvāpi śṛṇuyādvā nararṣabhaḥ ||
upetya bhāryāṃ gṛdyāṃ ca ramate prīti pūrvakam |
kāṇḍānte brāhmaṇāḥ pūjyāḥ pūjyassītāpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||
sītāsameta pratimā rāghavasya manoramām | caturviṃśatpalaiḥ kṛtvā tadardhaiḥ pādasaṃmitaiḥ ||
jāmbūnadaissamārādhya dadyādvidvaddvijanmane | nidhāya pūrṇakalaśe kṣaumopari śucismite ||
sahasrasammitairvittaistadardhaiḥ pādamātrakaiḥ | yathā śaktipramāṇena vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
dakṣiṇā sahitandadyādvāñchitārtha susiddhaye | dhar'nīgarbhasaṃbhūte dharaṇīdharavallabhe ||
dharaṇīmme prayacchāśu prītābhava śucismite | kausalyāgarbhasaṃbhūta bhūbhāroddhāraṇa prabho ||
pratimādāna tuṣṭassan vāñchitārtha susiddhaye | vaktā prāṅmukha āsīta śrotācottaradiṅmukhaḥ ||
nityaṃ dvijānsamārādhya yathā vibhavavistaram | viṣṭaraṃ māruteḥ kṛtvā bhakṣyairbhojyaiśca pūjayet ||
datvā tāmbūlamatulaṃ śṛṇo tu mukhatuṣṭaye | haviṣyāśī svayaṃ bhūyādbhāryayā niyatātmavān ||
vakturmukhaṃ samālokya śṛṇuyātkārya siddhaye | vaktāraṃ rāmabudhyā tu pūjayenvahaṃ priye ||
[ityumā saṃhitayāṃ rāmāyaṇakathāphalaprastāve bālakāṇḍakathāphala varṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhodhyāyaḥ] ||
maheśvaraḥ(-)
sahadevairudīrṇasya rāvaṇasya vadhārthibhiḥ | arthito mānuṣe loke jajñe viṣṇussanātanaḥ ||
viśeṣaṇaṃ hareśśṛṇvan kvacitskandhānvayaṃ tathā | kvacidrūpakathanaṃ kvacijjñāna pradarśanam ||
yo nityaṃ śṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ | sarvabandhavinirmukto harimandirago bhavet ||
paṭṭābhiṣekasaṃbhārānvasiṣṭhena pracoditān | sauvarṇādīni ratnāni balīnsarvauṣadhīrapi ||
ityādīni sadā śṛṇvan prātaḥ kāle mahīpatiḥ | sthiraṃ rājyaṃ samāsādya priyaputraiśca modate ||
viproṣitaśca bharato yāvadeva purāditaḥ | tāvadevābhiṣekaste prāptakālo mato mama ||
kāmaṃ khalusatāṃ vṛtte bhrātā te bharatassthitaḥ | jyeṣṭhānuvṛttī dharmātmā sānukrośo jitendriyaḥ ||
kinnucittaṃ manuṣyāṇāmanityamiti me matiḥ | jyeṣṭhasya rājatā nityamucitā hi kulasya ca ||
iti provāca bharatassarvānpaurajanānprati |
tādṛśe ko vicārosti svacchacittasya bhūpateḥ |
maheśvaraḥ(-)
śṛṇuvakṣyāmi tatvena rājā paṅktirathāhvayaḥ | hṛdi śaṅkānnidhāyaiva girivrajapuraṃ prati ||
bharataṃ preṣayāmāsa rājā daśarathassutam | kanyāmmanojñāmākarṇya kekayākhyasya bhūpateḥ ||
gatvā tāṃ varayāmāsa patnyarthaṃ kekayādhipaḥ | so'pi vavre varaṃ rājā dāsyāmi tava kanyakām ||
asyāmutpatsyate yosau sa tu rājā vidhīyatām | tathāstviti pratijñāya gṛhītā kekayātmajā ||
tasyāmutpāditaḥ putro bharato nāma viśrutaḥ |
umā(-)
rājño daśarathasyāsya mṛṣāvāditvamāgatam ||
pratijñollaṃghanaṃ rājñaḥ kāraṇadvitayādbhavet | kekayādhipateścāpi tatputryāḥ kāraṇāntare ||
kaikeyyā grahaṇecāpi tasyāssāraśyakarmaṇi |
maheśvaraḥ(-)
vivāhasamaye rājñā pratijñātamidaṃ śṛṇu ||
paṭṭābhiṣekasamaye bhaveyaṃ smārito yadi | tvayā vānyena bhūpāla tathā cetkaravāṇyaham ||
itthaṃ pratijñāmakaro papāta grahaṇe nṛpaḥ |
praṇamantaṃ samutthāpya taṃ pariṣvajya bhūmipaḥ ||
tasmāt pitrornamaskārassāṣṭāṅgaśśruticoditaḥ | vinā sāṣṭāṅgamanyena kurvannarakamaśnute ||
devarṣi pitṛ viprāṇāmanṛṇosmi tathātmanaḥ |
umā(-)
jāyamānasya viprasya ṛṇānāṃ tritayaṃ saha ||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāṃcaiva kathaṃ vedavinākṛtam | maṅgalaṃ prāpyate martyaśśrutvā sāketavarṇanam ||
gurumānjāyate martye gurupūjā vidhiśrutau | dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svastīrṇe kuśasaṃstare ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ śivo dhyeyaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ harissmṛtaḥ | hiraṇyagarbho vaiśyānāmupasyabdha dṛśasmṛtaḥ ||
iti dyotayi tuṃ rāmassvātmānamanusandadhe | kubjā devaissamādiṣṭā kaikeyīṃ bhettumārabhet ||
bālya evahi mā tulyaṃ bharataḥ prāpitastvayā | dhannikarṣācca sauhārdo jāyate sthāvareṣvapi ||
tasmātsamakṣe vastavyaṃ svasya bhūmimabhīpsataḥ | āsannaṃ bhajate nārī āsannaḥ paripūjyate ||
āsannaṃ bhajate rājā āsannaṃ bhajate latā | strīṇāṃ kauṭilyamākhyānaṃ śūlyālaṃkāravarṇanāt ||
devi kenābhi yuktāsi ityādigranthavistaraiḥ | kāmācāro bhavetkāmo vṛddhānāṃ yūnikā kathā ||
kāmātu rāṇāṃ bhūloke adeyannāsti kutracit | śapete jīvanārheṇa iti śāpaṃ vṛthāṃ nṛpaḥ ||
satyenāpi śapedyastu devagurvagnisannidhau | tasyā vaivasvato rājā dharmasyārdhaṃ nikṛntati ||
evaṃ sthitopi rājarṣiḥ kāmabāṇena pīḍitaḥ | aśapadrāmamuddiśya pāśabandhamṛgānvitaḥ ||
satyena lokāñjayati dīnāndānena rāghavaḥ | gurūñchuśrūṣayā vīro dhanuṣā yudhi śātravān ||
satyandānantapastyāgo mitratā śaucamārjavam | vidyā ca guruśuśrūṣā dhruvāṇyetāni rāghave ||
hariścandrastu satyena śibirdānena bhūtale | kodaṇḍenārjunaśśatrūn raghuśśuśrūyayā gurūn ||
viśvāmitrastu tapasā ārjavena yudhiṣṭhiraḥ | janako vidyayā cāpi ekaikaguṇayogataḥ ||
lokānāṃ vijayaṃ kṛtvā prasiddhā abhayannṛpāḥ | dhruvāṇyetāni rājendra rāghave kṛtaketanāḥ ||
rāmopi bharatādbhūyaḥ tava śuśrūṣate sadā | vahnīnāmekabhāryeṇāmekā putravatī yadi ||
sarvāstāstena putreṇa putravatyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ | yathā mātari śuśrūṣāṃ vidadhyādaurasassutaḥ ||
tadvanmātṛsapatnyāṃ tu aihikaṃ pāralaukikam | anārya iti māmāryāḥ putravikrayiṇaṃ dhruvam ||
dhikkariṣyanti rathyāsu surāpaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yathā | putranna vikrayaṃ kuryānna dadyāddravyalolupaḥ ||
dadyādyadi naro lobhāt pundi pacyeta vikrayī | brāhmaṇonnṛsurā peyā gaulyādyāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ ||
surāpaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā kulatyāgo vidhīyate | punvā jananavelāyāṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam ||
dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭāva bahudhā kāśyapatvāt svayaṃ nṛpam | tanmayā mohito bhūtvā bhaktyā rāmamanusmaran ||
māsma me bharataḥ kārṣīt pretakṛtyaṃgatāyuṣaḥ | ityādi pralapannrājā kaikayīvaramohitaḥ ||
śrutvāvicitraṃ karuṇaṃ vilāpaṃ (* * * * * *) | (* * * * *) bharturnṛśaṃsā na cakāra vākyam ||
devaissaṃprārthito devi māyāviśvaṃ bharasya tu | kekayāpatya vādena jātā viśvasya guptaye ||
sāmayā bhedayāmāsa rājānamakuto bhayam | caturaśro rathaśśrīmānnistriṃśo dhanuruttamam ||
vāhanannarasaṃyuktañchatraṃ ca śaśisannibham | turīyaṃ varṇakamidaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam ||
bhajatāṃ sarvadoṣaghnaṃ saṃsārabhayanāśanam | tuṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ caiva sarvaiśvarya pravartakam ||
rāmābhiṣekasaṃbhārāṃ chrutvāmaṅgalamāpnuyāt | rājyaṃ dvijātibhirjuṣṭaṃ rājasūyābhiṣecanam ||
kartumarhati te rājā vāsavasyeva lokakṛt | imaṃ mantraṃ samuccārya preṣayeddūragaṃ priyam ||
sarvānkāmānavāpyaiva punarbandhuṣu yujyate | pūrvāṃ diśaṃ vajradharo dakṣiṇāṃ pātu te yamaḥ ||
varuṇaḥ paścimāmāśāndhaneśastūttarāṃ diśam | sītākavaca yuktāṃgo yāṃ yāṃ yāti diśaṃ prati ||
tāntānkāmānavāpyaiva labhate śāśvataṃ padam | yaśca rāmanna paśyettu yaṃ ca rāmo na paśyati ||
ninditassa bhavelloke svātmāpyenaṃ vigarhate | rāmaṃ vā rāmaberaṃ vā rāmanāmānyathāpi vā ||
vīkṣeta śṛṇuyādvāpi sa naro mukti bhāgbhavet | yajñairdānaistapasā nāśanena badhvā viṣṇokhyayasya prasādam ||
labdhvā sākṣācchāśvataṃ kṛcchrāt moktuṃ devīṃ kāñcitenālpa kālam ||
śrutvā lakṣmaṇa vākyāni kausalyārāmayoḥ purā | satyena dhanuṣā caiva datteneṣṭena te śape ||
haniṣye pitaraṃ vṛddhaṃ kaikeyyā vaśamāgatam | ityādi śravaṇātpuṃsā kṣātrantejobhi vardhate ||
tvayā mayā ca vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena sumitrayā | piturniyoge sthātavyameṣa dharmassanātanaḥ ||
atretihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi pāvanaṃ pūrvasaṃbhavam | avantī viṣaye kaścit kirātānvaya saṃbhavaḥ ||
dharmavyādha iti khyātaḥ pitroḥ pūjāparāyaṇaḥ | āpaṇasthaṃ sadā māṃsaṃ krītvākrayaṇa tatparaḥ ||
krayalabdhairbahudravyaiḥ pitṛpūjāparo bhavat | abhyajya pitarau nityaṃ snāpanaṃ coṣṇavāriṇā ||
kṛtvā subhojyaṃ bhojyānnairvīṭikārpaṇa pūrvakam | mañce nidhāya pitarau kṛtapādābhivandanaḥ ||
evaṃ dine dine kurvan vyādho'pi svargamabhyagāt | śrutvā dhamārtha kāmeti dharmabhāgjāyate narāḥ ||
śrutvā rāghava vākyāni vanapravrājanaṃ prati | rāmaprasādamāsādya rāmasāyujya gāminaḥ ||
śrutvā lakṣmaṇavākyāni rāghavendrasya sannidhau | mitramabhyantaraṃ labdhvā śatrūṇāṃ vijayaṃ labhet ||
santi dharmo padā ślakṣṇā dharmātman ki budhyase | tayossucaritaṃ svārthaṃ śāṭhyāt parijihīrṣatoḥ ||
purā tu brāhmaṇaḥ kaścit kaliṅga viṣaye mahān | śrutādhyāya na saṃpanno vedādhyayana laṃpaṭaḥ ||
cūlyākhyo bahukālantu dravyārjanaparāyaṇaḥ | pratigrahādhyāpanayā yājakebhyo dhanārjanam ||
dhanena pūrṇapratilabdhakāmaḥ kiñciddhanaṃ brāhmaṇasānnakārṣīt | dharmasya nāśātpiśunāśca corā kṛpīḍayonirnṛpatiśca ruṣṭaḥ ||
vināśayā māsurathāsya vittaṃ savittanāśāt paritāpitobhūt ||
dharmasya lopānmadacittanāśo babhūva ityuktiparo dvijobhūt | dharmaṃ cariṣyāma iti bruvāṇo vittārjunaṃ dharmamiṣeṇa cakreḥ ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayiṣyāmi taṭākān khātayāmyaham | prapāḥ pravartayiṣyāmi kariṣye devapūjanam ||
taddravyeṇākarotsvasya saṃsāraparipūraṇām | kiñciddharmaṃ hyayaṃ cakre noceddāsyanti te mama ||
parārthe dharmakārtāro dharmavikrayiṇastathā | mataṅgajā bhaviṣyanti piśācā vā na saṃśayaḥ ||
etādṛśā mahīdevā kṣatraviṭchūdrajāstathā | iti rāmeṇa kathitaṃ priye proktaṃ mayādhunā ||
śṛṇuṣvā paramākhyānaṃ svargasyāsya purātanam | purā kaścinmahīpālaḥ kuntī bhoja iti śrutaḥ ||
pṛthivīṃ pālayāmāsa kṣatradharmamanusmaran | tādṛśasya mahībhartuḥ rājānaḥ paripaṃthinaḥ ||
nyarundhantasya nagaraṃ caturaṅgabalairyutāḥ | nirundhaṃ nagaraṃ vīkṣya hehayaistāla jaṃghajaiḥ ||
yuddhāya kṛtasannāho rathādi balasaṃyutaḥ | purānnirgatya sa bahukṛtavāñjanyamuttamam ||
naṣṭeṣu dravyajāteṣu bhagneṣu gajavājiṣu | puramāgamya bhūpālaḥ kiṃ kāryamiti cintayat ||
cintāviṣṭaṃ nṛpaṃ prāha purodhāḥ kāryasādhakaḥ | rāghavendre vanaṃ gantuṃ pitrādiṣṭe kṛtatvare ||
kausalyā kārayāmāsa putramaṅgalavācakam | tadidānīṃ prayuñjāno yuddhaṃ kuru yathā balam ||
brāhmaṇānsamyagāhūya svastivācanapūrvakam | hutvā vaiṣṇavamantraiśca kṛtvā brāhmaṇabhojanam ||
āśiṣonte vidhāyaiva kṛtamaṅgalapūrvakam | yuddhaṃ kuru mahābāho śatrūñjeṣyasi mā ciram ||
ityuktvā kārayāmāsa dvijaiśca sapurohitaiḥ | sāpanīya tamāyāsamupaspṛśyajalaṃ śuci ||
cakāra mātā rāmasya maṅgalāni yaśasvinī | ityupakramya maṅgalya jagāmetyantamāditaḥ ||
brāhmaṇairvācayāmāsa vijayārthaṃ nṛpasya ca | yuddhāya kṛtasannaddho nirjagāma purottamāt ||
hehayaistālajaṅghaiśca yuddhamāsītkṛtāravam | pravṛtte ghoratasi bāṇāsāra prapīḍitam ||
bhagnaṃ rāgakulaṃ sarvaṃ vidrutaṃ sarvato diśam | kṣaṇamātreṇa teṣveko nahya dṛśyata bhūtale ||
prayāṇa samaye japtvā tu kāryasiddhirbhaviṣyati | deśāntaragātānāṃ ca punarāvṛttisiddhidam ||
vratopavāsaratayā bhavitavyaṃ tvayā naye | ityādi granthasandarbhai strīdharmaṃ prāharāghavaḥ ||
proṣite nāyake strībhirharidrākuṅkumaṃ tathā | kañcukīṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ vāpi na dhāryaṃ bhūtimicchatā ||
keśasaṃskārakaraṇaṃ citrāṇi vasanāni ca | ārya putra pitā mātā bhrātā putrastathāsnuṣā ||
svāni puṇyāni bhuñjānā svaṃ svaṃ bhāgyamupāsate | bharturbhāgyaṃ tu bhāryaikāmāpnoti puruṣarṣabha ||
ataścaityādi sandarbhaissītā provāca rāghavam | atreti hāsaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārvati tatvataḥ ||
nalo nāma purā rājā cakravartī nararṣabhaḥ | pṛthivīṃ pālayāmāsa yathāśāstraṃ yathā mati ||
tasya daivavaśāddyute pravṛttirūpapadyate | kalinā jitasarvasvo rājya bhraṃśamavāptavān ||
tasyāṅganā tu vaidehī tadduḥkhādduḥkhinī bhavet | hariścandraśca bhāryā ca bhartṛduḥkhamupeyitā ||
tasmādahaṃ tvayā sārdhaṃ vanaṃ yāsyāmirāghava | kiṃ tvāmanyata vaidehaḥ pitā me mithilādhipaḥ ||
rāmaṃjāmātaraṃ prāpya striyaṃ puruṣavigraham | atrāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi purāvṛttaṃ raghūttama ||
purā narapatiḥ kaścidarakṣadavanīmimām | svardhunī tanaye rājau parājayamavāptavān ||
gāṅgenyaṃ hantukāmosau śivārādhanako bhavat | siddhe tapasi taṃ prāha śaṃbhurgaṅgādharassvayam ||
bho bho narendra kiṃ kāryaṃ tapaścarasi khedataḥ | ityukte prāha bhūpālaḥ paramānandanirbharaḥ ||
bhīṣmahantāramicchāmi karṇe kālavaro mama | ityukte dattavāndevo nirvitaṃ bhīṣmanāśane ||
katicitkālamāsādya strītvaṃ puṃstvamavāpsyasi | iti dattavaro rājā puramāpa kutūhalāt ||
tasya bhāryāsutāṃ kāle janayāmāsa suprabhām | rājā śivasya vākyena putro jāta iti bruvan ||
jātakarmādisaṃskāramakarot puruṣe yathā | tāmantarā tu tanayāṃ śikhaṇḍīmudavāhayat ||
rātrau vinodasamaye jñātvā nārīṃ śikhaṇḍinam | pitre saṃpreṣayāmāsa śīghraṃ sandeśahāriṇam ||
śrutvā vṛttāntamatyugraṃ caturaṅgabalairvṛtaḥ | sambandhinagaraṃ roṣādākramyāniṣṭhadañjasā ||
evaṃ śuśrāva vṛttāntaṃ striyaṃ puruṣavigraham | sītārāghavayorvākyaṃ ye śṛṇvanti mahītale ||
tau daṃpatī sadā khedātsyātāṃ muktau bhavāccave | rāmopi vittaṃ viprāṇāṃ datvā vanagato bhavat ||
lokāntaraṃ gantukāmaiḥ kācamātrañca dīyate | nava pañca ca varṣāṇi navavāsaṃ vihṛtyate ||
punaḥ pādau gṛhīṣyāmi pratijāno narādhipa | vadhyevāradvayannāsti sthāpite nāsti cālanam ||
rāme vārtādvayaṃ nāsti nāsti yuktararāghava'pi | śreyase vṛddhaye tāna punarāgamanāya ca ||
gacchasvāriṣṭamavyagraḥ panthāna makuto bhayam | naivāhaṃ rājyamicchāmi na sukhaṃ na ca maithilīm ||
naiva sarvānimānkāmānsvargaṃ naiva ca jīvitam | idaṃ proktvā prasthitānāṃ prasthāpanavidhirbhavet ||
te yānti siddhasaṃkalpā dṛḍhadehā dhanādhipāḥ | punarbandhusametāśca modante divi devavat ||
pūrṇasya brahmaṇo rājye icchā tasmādbhaviṣyati | lābhālābhe duḥkhasukhe kāryākārye priyāpriye ||
advaite nirviśeṣākhye māyāleśo na vidyate | kaikeyī bhartsanaṃ śrutvā vasiṣṭhamuni bhāṣitam ||
naśyanti sarvapāpāni tārkṣyaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathoragāḥ |
umā(-)
etādṛśāstriyassanti kimvalodvegakārikāḥ | bharturudvejinī nārī vyālī bhavati kānane ||
bharturagre tu bhuñjānā laṃpate jatu vartikā | kathaṃ drohaṃ prakurvanti striyakānte svadaivate ||
etadācakṣva deveśa mama kāmaprapūraka |
maheśvaraḥ(-)
śṛṇu vakṣyāmi deveśi kiñcidākhyānamuttamam | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa vibhyanti sakalāsstriyaḥ ||
jyeṣṭhā dāsīnnarapati priyaṃ vada iti bhutaḥ | śrutādhyayana saṃpanno mahīṃ dharmeṇa pālayan ||
tasya bhāryādvayamabhūdekā tu sumukhābhidhā | anyā kanaka varṇāṅgī dharmeṇoḍhā bhavatstriyaḥ ||
jyeṣṭhā prasūta tanayaṃ kadrūṃ kāmākṛtiṃ śubham | anyātvajījanatputramambujā kṣeti viśrutam ||
priyaṃvadākhyo nṛpati raghu tatra tayaṃ samāḥ | kṛtvā rājyaṃ jīrṇa vapuḥ putraṃ rājānamaicchata ||
prakṛtīssamyagāhūya cintayāmāsa vai hitam | tasminnavasare dūtaṃ jñātvā rājñaścikīrṣitam ||
hemāṅgī kathayāmāsa kadrūrājyasya bhāvitām | saḥ puṣyayoge jyeṣṭhāyā putraṃ kadrabhidhānakam ||
abhiṣekṣyati dharmeṇa prajāpālanakarmaṇi | ityukte suprajajvāla kopena jvalitānanā ||
dyūtiṃ kanakavarṇāṅgī uttaraṃ samapṛcchata | sā cintayitvā tāṃ prāha sāhasaṃ paramauṣadham ||
rātrau prasupte nṛpatau śiraḥ khaḍgena lāvaya | mṛte pitari rājātu bhavitā tvatsuto naghe ||
mūlaṃ balaṃ tvatsutasya tasya nāsti hi kovi hi | tathā prabodhitā rājñī tathā śraddhāñcakāra vai ||
siddhaḥ kaściddadau rājñe mantraṃ kambalikāṃ prati | sā tasya karṇe japati sarvaṃ vṛttāntamāditaḥ ||
atha vedita vṛttāntaḥ kimetaditi cintayat | sā niścitārthaḥ padati nānṛtaṃ vakti karhicit ||
kūṭamabhyantaraṃ śuddhaṃ śuddhāntacaralaṃpaṭam | prāha bhṛtyamathājñapto talpādhaśśeṣvame niśi ||
itthaṃ śuddhānta sañcārakuśalaṃ kañcanaṃ vyadhāt | rātrau kanakavarṇāṅgyā kṛtabhogo narādhipaḥ ||
nidrāvaśamagātsā ca mahiṣī nidritā bhavat | piśācyā karṇabodhinyā bodhino nṛpasattamaḥ ||
utthāya śīghramabhyarṇe nidrāluṃ bhṛtyamañjasā | talpe nidhāya tasyādhaḥ svayannidrāmupāgamat ||
etasminnantare sāpi prabuddhā cintayatsvayam | kṛtvā vikośannistriṃśaṃ keśapakṣe parāmṛśat ||
strībudhyā sāhasānmaurkhyācciccheda śira uttamam | itthaṃ prajñāta vṛttānto niśānte bhūpatissvayam ||
śūlāgre tāṃ samāropya śayiṣṭa sasukhaṃ samāḥ | etādṛśyasstriyassanti sāhasa pravarānvitāḥ ||
sāketapuranāthasya piturdaśarathasya ca | svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa sahasrārkasamaprabham ||
sahasra śirasaṃ nityaṃ sahasrākṣamanāmayam | sahasrabāhupādoruṃ sarvatassamavasthitam ||
jaṭāṃ triṇetraṃ gaṅgāṃ ca vibhrāṇaṃ pralayānalam | śaṅkhaṃ cakrañca kaumodīnnandakañca kamaṇḍalum ||
pinākaṃ dhavalaṃ raktaṃ kārṣṇañcaiva vapurdharam | grasantaṃ sarvabhūtāni vyāktānanamivāntakam ||
dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ harestuṣṭāstuṣṭāva parameśvaram |
māṃ śivam |
madhuvannojasi tu vāñchāṃ kurvanti saraghā yathā ||
tadvanmāṃ jñātatatvoyaṃ na jahāti kadācana | iti matvā svayaṃ māyāntatāna nṛpamohinīm ||
iyaṃ dhārmika kausalyā mama mātā yaśasvinī | vṛddhā cākṣudraśīlā ca na tvāṃ deva vigarhite ||
mayā vihīnāṃ varada prapannāṃ śokasāgare | adṛṣṭapūrvavyasanāṃ bhūyassamantu mahasi ||
itthaṃ māyāmohitastu gamanāya matiṃ dadhe | sītākausalyayorvākyaṃ pātivratyopadarśanam ||
śrutvā strī prāpnuyānnityaṃ patiśuśrūṣaṇāphalam |
dānavendraṃ hatandṛṣṭvā timidhvajasutaṃ raṇe | sa śūraḥ puruṣavyāghrassvabāhu balamāśritaḥ ||
asantrasthopyaraṇyasso veśmanīvanivatsvati |
umā(-)
anukto muninā kvāpi siddhavatkathyate katham | etadā ca kṣvamannātha raghunātha parākramam ||
maheśvaraḥ(-)
kṛtodvāho dāśarathissāketanagare male | pitṛśuśrūṣaṇarato mātṛśuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ ||
guruśuśrūṣaṇe saktaḥ prajāpālana tatparaḥ | niyukto guruṇā rāmaḥ śikṣayansakalāḥ prajāḥ ||
dinānte janakaṃ sarvaṃ vijñāpyānuṣṭhitaṃ mahat | gṛhaṃ praviśya rāmassa sītāyā sukhito bhavat ||
evaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi kṛtavānpariścanam | timidhvajasya tanayaśatamāyo mahābalaḥ ||
daṇḍakāraṇyamabhyetya kosalānparyapīḍayat | śrutvā daśarathastūrṇaṃ sannāhena samanvitaḥ ||
caturaṅgabalopetaḥ purāttūrṇaṃ viniryayau | akṣauhiṇīdvayopeto daṇḍakānpratyapadyata ||
timidvajasya tanayaśśatamāyo mahābalaḥ |
balena mahatā yukto yuddhāyāśu viniryayau ||
daṇḍakāraṇyamāsādya tasthau yuddhāya niścitaḥ | janyamāsīnmahāghoraṃ rakṣasāṃ manujāṃ tathā ||
etasminnantare rāmo dhanurviṣṣārayanmahat | vavarṣa śatavarṣāṇi rakṣaratāṃ prāṇaśāntaye ||
te bhagnadehamūrdhāno bhinnāśchinnā vidāritāḥ | tyaktvā prāṇānāji madhye yogi mṛgyaṃ padaṃ gatāḥ ||
tāndṛṣṭvā prāṇanirmuktān rākṣasānsa timidhvajaḥ | timidhvajasuto vīro māyāṃ prāvartayadyudhi ||
chantamāyābalenājau vīkṣya rāmo mahāraṇe | mumo cāstraṃ mahāvedaṃ śabda vedhyabhidhānakam ||
tena sañchinnahṛdayaḥ papāta ca mamāra ca | etasminnantare devaiḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiravarṣataḥ ||
sraṣṭā sarvasya lokasya rāmaṃ prāha mudānvitaḥ | astrandadāni divyante te yathā lakṣmaṇasya ca ||
dadāmi sarvadevānāṃ pathāvatpratibhāntu te | iti datvā varaṃ vedhāstatraivāntaradhīyata ||
śānte janye daśaratho rāmādi sahito jayī | puraṃ prāpya mudā yuktaḥ parāṃ prītimavāptavān ||
vartate cottamāṃ vṛttiṃ lakṣmaṇo'sminsadānaghaḥ |
dayāvānsarvabhūteṣu lābhastasya mahātmanaḥ ||
śrutvā devyā pañcamaṃ vṛttametat vāṇī śakyaṃ prāpnuyātkīrtanācca | ante vāṇī nātha lokaṃprapadya ante lokaṃ śāśvataṃ yāti martyaḥ ||
[ityumā saṃhitāyāṃ ayodhyākāṇḍaśravaṇaphalavarṇanannāma saptamodhyāyaḥ] ||
|| [athāṣṭamodhyāyaḥ] ||
mahādevaḥ(-)
gaṅgāmadhyagatā sādhvī prārthayāmāsa jāhnavīm | surāghaṭasahastreṇa māṃsabhūtodanena ca ||
yakṣyo tvāṃ prayatā devī nagarīṃ punarāgatā | pāyasena dvijaiḥ pūjyā kṣatriyairgavyasarpiṣā ||
vaiśyaiḥ pūjyā mākṣikeṇa surayā śūdrajātibhiḥ | darśādīṣṭyādi tithiṣu pūjyā śaṅkaravallabhā ||
atideśena nārīṇāṃ śūdradharmoyamāgataḥ |
bharadvājo mahātejāḥ pūjayāmāsa rāghavam ||
nānāvidhānannarasān vanyamūlaphalāśrayān | tebhyo dadau mahātejā vāsañcaivānvakalpayat ||
umā(-)
madhumūlaphalarjīvaṃ hitvā munivadāmiṣam | iti rāmeṇa gaditaṃ jananyaigacchatā vanam ||
paścādrāmeṇa kathitaṃ gaṅgāsantāraṇātparam |
tau tatra hatvā caturo mahāmṛgān varāha mṛgyaṃ pṛṣataṃ mahārurum | ādāya medhyantvaritaṃ bubhukṣitā vāsāya kāle yayaturvanaspatiḥ ||
phalamūlāśinau dāntau tāpasau dharmacāriṇau | iti nānāprakāreṇa saṃśayo vartate mama ||
chindye tatsaṃśayaṃ kānta cāritre rāghavasya tu |
maheśvaraḥ(-)
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi saṃśayaṃ chedmi suvrate |
etatsarvamabhipretya
nivārānnaṃ kvacidrāmaḥ kvacidāmiṣabhojanam | madhunā kvacidāhāraṃ phalamūlaiḥ kvacidbhavet ||
vane nivasatā tatra kṛtaṃ rāmeṇa suvrate |
etatsarvamabhipretya munivatpadamaṅganne |
umā(-)
tīrtvā himodbhavāṃ gaṅgāṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt | jāgartavyamatandribhyāmadya prabhṛti rātriṣu ||
yogakṣemo hi sītāyā vartate lakṣmaṇāvayoḥ | ityuktaṃ raghunāthena gaṅgāsantāraṇātparam ||
tañjāgrataṃ guṇairyuktaṃ varacāpeṣu dhāriṇam | bhrātṛ guptyarthamarthamahaṃ lakṣmaṇamabruvam ||
itthaṃ niṣādādhipatiḥ proktavānbharataṃ prati | itthaṃ dhanurdharobhūtvā uṭajadvāri lakṣmaṇaḥ ||
atiṣṭhatsarvamāvṛtya iti prāha mahāmuniḥ | idānīṃ bhaṇyate tena muninā lakṣmaṇaṃ prati ||
mahau nidrāṃ ca tandrīṃ ca prasaktaṃ ca pariśramam | rātrau dhanurdharo bhūtvā rakṣatyatulavikramaḥ ||
maheśvaraḥ(-)
triyāmāyāḥ tṛtīyāṃśe nidrāṃ kiñcitkarotyasau | śrutvā vedavaraṃ kālye munivṛndaissamīritam ||
rakṣasānnavakāśo'sti vedadhvani vijṛṃbhaṇāt | tasmātpracetasāpyuktaṃ kiñcinnidrā pradarśakam ||
atha rātryāṃ vyatītāyāmavasuptamanantaram |
prabodhayāmāsa śanairlakṣmaṇaṃ raghunandanaḥ | kausalyā nṛpatiṃ prāha putravyasanakarśitā ||
bhojayanti kila śrāddhe ke svāneva bāndhavān | tataḥ paścātsamīkṣante kṛtakāryāndvijarṣabhān ||
tatra ye guṇavantaśca vidvāṃsaśca dvijātayaḥ | na paścātte bhimanyante sudhāmapi suropamāḥ ||
brāhmaṇeṣu vitṛpteṣu paścādbhoktuṃ dvijarṣabhān | nābhyupetumalaṃ prājñāḥ śṛṅgachedamivarṣabhāḥ ||
evaṃ kanīyasā bhrātrā bhuktaṃ rājyaṃ viśāṃpate | bhrātā jyeṣṭho variṣṭhaśca kimarthañcābhimaṃsyati ||
atreti hāsaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu śailendrakanyake | purā duryodhano nāma rājā dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ||
sūryavaṃśasamudbhūto dharme satye ca niṣṭhitaḥ | śāṇḍilyākhyo mahātejāḥ purodhā abhavanmuniḥ ||
tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya rājño duryodhanasya vai | piturdinaṃ haridine babhūva mṛtiyogataḥ ||
śāṇḍilyaṃ varayāmāsa pitrarthaṃ brahmavittamam | etasminnabhyayādvipro vārṣagaṇya iti śrutaḥ ||
tandṛṣṭvā pūjayāmāsa rājā duryodhanābhidhaḥ | pitrarthe prārthayāmāsa vipraṃ brahmavidāṃvaram ||
omiti prāha rājñe tu snātuṃ godāvarīṃ gataḥ | cirāyite vārṣagaṇye rājā cintākulo bhavat ||
prātaḥ pāraṇamākhyātaṃ dvādaśyāṃ tatvadarśibhiḥ | dvādaśīguṇayogena tatkāle havyakavyayoḥ ||
smṛti śāstraṃ hṛdi dadhau śāṇḍilyokta maharniśam | anāgate vārṣagaṇye śrāddhaṃ kartumathārabhat ||
nirvartya pitryaṃ vidhivadṛṣerāgamanaṃ nṛpaḥ | pratīkṣya pāraṇāṃ kṛtvā jalenātiṣṭhadāsane ||
etasminnantare vārṣagaṇyākhyaḥ kṛtamajjanaḥ | abhyarṇaṃ bhūpateḥ prāptaḥ pāraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ ||
tandṛṣṭvā kṛta satkāraṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahīpatim | krodhena mahatāviṣṭho vyāhartumupacakrame ||
nimantrya pitrye māṃ rājannupekṣyā kriyate katham | dadmiśāpaṃ mahīpālamavamāna kṛto yataḥ ||
bhūpatiḥ(-)
śrutvā śāṇḍilyavacanaṃ śāstraṃ dvādaśivāsare | idaṃ vṛtaṃ mayā vipra śāstraṃ te śrāvayāmyaham ||
ekādaśīdine prāpte anne tiṣṭhanti pātakāḥ | annāśī pāpamaśnāti dadyānnānnaṃ harerdine ||
annavastrarato vāpi dadyānnānnaṃ harerdine |
ekādaśyāmannadātā rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet ||
havyakavyāni karmāṇi na dadyāddharivāsare | dvādaśyāmeva kurvīta taddinaśrāddhameva ca ||
prātaḥ kālamati kramya kuryācchrāddhādikaṃ yadi | upavāsodbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ na dharmañcādhigacchati ||
nāśnanti pitaraḥ kavyaṃ kālāti kramaṇaṃ yadi | iti śāstraṃ samālokya dattaṃ śrāddhamiha dvija ||
nṛpeṇoktamidaṃ śrutvā kopena jvalitānanaḥ | tāntrikāṇāmayaṃ dharmo vedaniṣṭhairbahiṣkṛtaḥ ||
tantreṣu dīkṣito bhūtvā tantrācārarato bhava | iti śāpaṃ nṛpe kṛtvā gatavān svarasya cāśramam ||
hā rāghava mahābāho hā mamāyāsanāśanaḥ | hā pitṛpriya me nātha hā mamādhigatassuta ||
iti mātuśca rāmasya sumitrāyāśca sannidhau | rājā daśarathaśśocan śayānontamupāgamat ||
yaṃ bhāvaṃ hṛdi vinyasya dehaṃ tyajati mānavaḥ | tanna māpnoti dehānte bhāvaṃ bhāvanayā yutaḥ ||
rāghavasmaraṇe naiva mṛtiṃ prāpto mahīpatiḥ | tathāpi gatavānsvargaṃ kāśyapatvāddhareḥ pitā ||
putraśokāturāṃ bandhau śepurdaśarathannṛpam |
tvāmaptyātādṛśo bhāvaḥ kṣiprameva gamiṣyati ||
jīvitāntakaro yoro dātāramiva dakṣiṇāḥ | tasmāddrohaṃ na kurvīta ṛṣiṣva jñānato'pi vā ||
yadi duḥkhānprapadyante yathā daśaratho nṛpaḥ | sametya rājakartāraḥ sabhāmīyurdvijātayaḥ ||
nārājake janapade ityādi grantha vistaraiḥ | śrutvā mahīpatīnāṃ tu vināśo nāstyakālataḥ ||
svapnānāṃ gatayāḥ proktāḥ kālajā rogajāstathā | vātajāḥ pittajāścaiva śleṣmajā mantrajāstathā ||
devatā veśavaśagā svapnānāṃ gatayo hyamūḥ | dussvapnānāmapi tathā bhavanti pratibhā balāt ||
samudraśoṣaṇaṃ cāpi nadīśoṣaṇameva ca | parvatātpatanañcāpi āhvānaṃ kṛṣyāyoṣitā ||
śakṛnmayahrade snānaṃ śiraso muṇḍanaṃ tathā | vṛkṣaparvatabhedañca mūrdhnivajrasya pātanam ||
evamādīni duḥkhāni dṛṣṭvā santaptamānasaiḥ | taddoṣaśamanārthāya japtavyaṃ prayatātmabhiḥ ||
yāmeva rātriṃ te dūtā praviśanti sma tāṃ purīm | bharatenāpi tāṃ rātriṃ svapne dṛṣṭo yamapriyaḥ ||
idaṃ sargaṃ prayoktṝṇāṃ dussvapnaśamanaṃ bhavet |
śrutvā śūnya purākhyānaṃ bharatena prabhāṣitam ||
rājñā tu nagaraṃ śūnyanna kadācit bhaviṣyati | grahāṇāṃ na vināśassyāt sarvathā grahamedhinām ||
bharatasya ca kaikeyyāssaṃvāda śravaṇānnṛṇām | pātakāni ca vibhyanti tārkṣyaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathoragāḥ ||
somātyamadhye saṃkruddho jananīmabhyakutsayat | jyeṣṭho hyakṛtadāre ca hyakṛtāgniparigrahe ||
dārāgniyogaṃ cakrusteye narā mūḍhacetanāḥ | parivettā parityājya iti śāstreṣu ninditaḥ ||
tadvajjyeṣṭhe vidyamāne kṛtabhūmi parigrahaḥ | parirājakatāṃ prāpya ninditassyājjagattraye ||
taddoṣaśamanārthāya jananīmabhyakutsayat | gurorapyavaliptasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ ||
utpathaṃ pratipannasya parityāgo vidhīyate | iti śāstraṃ samālocya mātaraṃ pratyakutsayat ||
kausalyāyāśca purato bharate na prabhāṣitam | śapatha prārthanaṃ sargaṃ yasyāryonumate gataḥ ||
ityādi śravaṇāt puṃsāmabhiśāpo na vidyate | atra te kathayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam ||
(* * *) na pratiṃ kaścit kṛtvā rājyammahattaram |
rājye'bhiṣecya tanayaṃ tapase gatavānvanam ||
viraktasya pravṛddhasya svarṇaromākhya bhūpateḥ | nirviśeṣaṃ paraṃ brahma dhyāyatassatatassuraiḥ ||
preṣitāḥ katiciccorā dhanā rājño niveśane | gṛhītvā bhūribahavo nirgatā rājaveśmanaḥ ||
pālakāssamyagājñāya anujagmurmalimlacān | taskarānpālakāñjñātvānturṇitandhanasañcayam ||
nidhāya jagmurvegena svarṇa romṇassamīpataḥ | moṣito vittanikaraḥ svarṇaromṇeti vādinaḥ ||
rājño nikaṭamāninyū rājarṣi pravaraṃ śubham | jñātvā suvarṇaromāṇaṃ praṇipātapurassaram ||
prasthāpayanmahīpālastasya māhātmya gauravāt | svarṇaste yasya viṣaye mithyāśāpoyamāgataḥ ||
iti budhyā svarṇaromaḥ prāyaścittamacintayat | arundhatī patiṃ gatvā prāyaścittamapṛcchata ||
upadiṣṭo vasiṣṭhena śapathaṃ bharatasya saḥ | jajānato na pūtātmā prāptavāndivyamandiram ||
prāgdvāre bhūttadā kubjā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā | liptā candanacāreṇa rājavastrāṇi bibhratī ||
svajanmanaḥ phalaṃ hema svayaṃ vā manikā satī |
nirvāpayāmāsa śanairdevānāṃ hitamicchati ||
tasmādbhaṣaṇa saṃkārai bhūṣaṇaṃ yujyate bhṛśam | bharatasya sasainyasya bharadvājasya satkṛtim ||
paṭhandadyāt pitṝṇāṃ hi akṣayya phalasiddhidam | jaṭilaṃ cīravasanaṃ prāñjaliṃ patitaṃ bhuvi ||
dadarśa rāmo durdarśaṃ yugānte bhāskaraṃ yathā | gāyatryā svarasaṃkhyātaṃ varṇakaṃ śṛṇu yādyat ||

smitvā bhikṣurathaprāha khinnaste pāṇilāghavaḥ | varāṭakaṃ pragṛhyatvaṃ yantā kiṃ yamamandiram ||
ityuktvā tasya bhavanānniścakrāma dayānidhiḥ | janmāntarārjitaiḥ puṇyaiḥ cittaśuddhimupāgataḥ ||
vṛdhāmāṃsāni jagdhāni kṛsarāṇi payodanam | śaṣkulīpiṇḍikāścāpi tilodanamataḥ param ||
sūpodanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca vṛddhā jagdhānyābhukṣṇaśaḥ | pratyabdaṃ pitṛtṛptiṃ ca na kṛtā dravyavāñchayā ||
taddoṣaśamanārthāya prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyatām | iti vijñāpitaṃ śrutvā vaiśyasya dvijapuṅgavāḥ ||
āloḍhya sarvaśāstrāṇi cakruḥ pāpavimocanam | pūrṇakuṃbhaḥ pratiṣṭhāpya kṣaumavastreṇa veṣṭitam ||
śrīrāmapratimāṃ kṛtvā samārādhya yathā vidhi | tandeśaṃ rākṣasī kācidājagāma yadṛcchayā ||
ityupakramya sarvāṇi jepurdvādaśapuṅgavāḥ | tandṛṣṭvā śatruhantārammaharṣīṇāṃ sukhāvaham ||
babhūva hṛṣṭā vaidehī bhartāraṃ pariṣasvaje | ityantairmantranikarairjaptā dvādaśabhūṣurāḥ ||
siṣṭi cu kuṃbhatoyena mukto bhūtpātakaudhataḥ | aṃkapanoditaṃ śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ ||
mārīcāśrama māsādya vasantantāṭakāsutam | sahāyaṃ varayāmāsa mārīcannāma rākṣasam ||
vāryamāṇassu bahuśo mārīcena sa rāvaṇaḥ | nivṛtya laṅkāṃ vegena tūrṇaṃ pratya prapadyata ||
laṅgāṃ śūrpaṇakhī gatvā rāvaṇaṃ prāharākṣasī | na ca devī na gandharvī nāsurī na ca rākṣasī ||
dṛṣṭapūrvā mayā nārī tvadarthe hartukā mayā | tadābhyarṇagatā tena vinā sā kāritā balāt ||
tasya bhāryāṃ hara kṣipraṃ tasmā (*) kṣyati jīvitam | yuddhena nāvakāśo'sti jetuṃ rāvaṇa karhicit ||
śrutvā daśagrīva guṇānuvarṇanaṃ sargaṃ viśiṣṭo bhavitā paritryām | śrīpārvatī śasya padānusevināṃ na labhyamastyaṇḍa vikṛtsnaloke ||
punarmārīca māsādya varayāmāsa rāvaṇaḥ | sāhāyyaṃ bahudhā sopi vārayāmāsa rāvaṇam ||
mārīcoktamupaśrutya gurumānbhavati kṣitau | jānakīmmohayāmāsa mārīcoṣṭāpado mṛgaḥ ||
bhūtvā māyā vikāreṇa sītāṃ māyāsvarūpiṇīm | māyā sarvānkṣobhayati vinārāghavasevinam ||
rāmo'pi bhāryāvākyena dūraṃ vanamadhāvata | rāmepuṇā hatasso'pi vissvanaṃ krośanaṃ vyadhāt ||
māṃ rantukāmo vipinaṃ bharatena svayantu vā | preṣitastava kāmānāṃ nāsti siddhiḥ kadācana ||
upadhāya karantasya kathamanyasya saṃśraye | na sidhyati mariṣyāmi tavaṭacchanacediha ||
sītākaṭhoravākyena tāḍito rāghavānujaḥ | visṛjya sītāṃ vegetya pārśvaṃ rāmasya jagmivān ||
tadantare khare yukto rāvaṇenāhṛto rathaḥ | sītānikaṭamabhyetya darśanaṃ samapadyata ||
taṃ visṛjya śikhi chatrī tridaṇḍī bhikṣuveṣadhṛt | sītānikaṭamāsādya tasthau brahma udīrayan ||
āgataṃ yatinaṃ vīkṣyā narcacāyatalocanā | yatīnāṃ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ striyā vā puruṣeṇa vā ||
yasya gehe yatirbhuṅkte tasya bhuṅkte harissvayam | yasya gehe harirbhuṅkte tasya bhuṅkte jagattrayam ||
sītārāvaṇasaṃvādaṃ ye śṛṇvanti narottamāḥ | na jātu teṣāṃ pāpebhyaḥ pīḍā tasya bhaviṣyati ||
daśagrīvaṃ pratiprāha tadā sītā yaśasvinī | mama bhartā mahātejā vayasā pañcaviṃśakaḥ ||
aṣṭādaśa ca varṣāṇi gaṇyante mama janmani | bhakārārṇamuniḥ prāha navamaṃ munisiddhidam ||
yadantaraṃ sihmasṛgālayorvane yadantaraṃ syandinikā samudrayoḥ | yadantaraṃ kāñcana sīsalohayoḥ yadantaraṃ madgumayūrayorvane ||
yadantaraṃ hasti viḍālayorvane tadantaraṃ dāśarathestavaiva ca |
ityādi vākyanikaraṃ śṛṇvatāṃ bhūtanāśanam | raghunāthasamā loke sati kimmanujeśubham ||
svarūpaṃ rāvaṇaṃ prāpya gṛhītuñjanakātmajām | prāptavānnikaṭaṃ tūrṇaṃ gṛhaḥ khe rohiṇī viva ||
vāmena sītāṃ padmākṣīṃ mūrdhajeṣu kareṇa saḥ | ūrvāstu dakṣiṇenaiva parijagrāha pāṇinā ||
tandṛṣṭvā giriśṛṅgābhaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ mahābhujam | prādravanmṛtyusaṃkāśaṃ bhayārtā vanadevatāḥ ||
chāyā grāhitvamasyāsti sarvavidyāviśārade | keśacchāyāṃ parāmṛśya jānuchāyāntathaiva ca ||
gṛhītvā jānakīṃ hṛṣṭo laṅkāṃ prāyātsarāvaṇaḥ | sītāpahāraśravaṇaṃ ye kurvanti narottamāḥ ||
na teṣāṃ vimukhā devī bhaviṣyati kadācana | ajñānaṃ vilayaṃ yāti rāghavasya prasādataḥ ||
krośantīṃ rāmarāmeti vīkṣyanyagrodhamāśritaḥ | rāvaṇaṃ yodhayāmāsa sītāmokṣaṇakāraṇāt ||
chatraṃ bāhuṃ tasya mauliṃ cāpaṃ sāṅgrāmikaṃ rathaṃ | kharānkeśānnakhaistuṇḍairalāvīdrāmahetave ||
śrutvā khageśvarasyāpi rakṣasāmīśvarasya ca | āyodhanaṃ raṇānmukto bhṛtya svāmikṛtānnijāt ||
rāvaṇo khaṇḍayatpakṣau candrahāsena vīryavān | sītāṃ gṛhītvā ca punardakṣiṇāśāṃ yayau balāt ||
rāvaṇāṅkagatā sītā śuśubhe madirekṣaṇā | kālikā madhyagā śaṃpā yathā vyomni prakāśate ||
tasyāḥ kauśeyamuddhutamākāśe hāṭakaprabham | pāṭitaṃ vāyunā pārśvāt kucamaṇḍalamaṇḍanam ||
tasminnābharaṇaṃ badhvā celakhaṇḍe mahīsutā | giripravaramadhyasthān pañcavānarasattamān ||
uddiśya pātayāmāsa rāvaṇo naiva buddhavān | visrastaṃ bhūsutāyāstu kvaciddhammikasaṃhati ||
galitaṃ bhūsutāyāstu kvacitkañcukabandhanam | abalena yutandevyā kvacittāmbūlacarvitam ||
kvacitstriyaḥ kvacitpuṃsaḥ tattadvastu vilepanam | cakrurdavyā kṛtaṃ yasmāttasmātsarve priye ime ||
sītāpahāramārabhya laṅkāyāṃ sthāpanāvadhi | śravaṇācchāstravihitājjeṣṭhā devī vimuñcati ||
sītārāvaṇasaṃvādaṃ rākṣasīnāñca tarjanam | sītā pratyuktikathanaṃ ye śṛṇvanti narottamāḥ ||
vidhūtapāpāste yānti brahmalokaṃ sanātanam | aśokavanikāmadhye pūjitā janakātmajā ||
āste maghavatā datta pāyasānnena jīvikā | rāmo māyāmṛgaṃ hatvā nyavartana mahāpathi ||
śakunaṃ vāyasaṃ cāpi lakṣmaṇasya ca darśanam | sītādurukti kathanaṃ lakṣmaṇasya mukhācchrutam ||
śrutvā na jātu pīḍā syādabhiśāpakṛtaṃ maha | atra te kathayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ jagātmaje ||
purā purūkhābhikhyo rājā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ | tapastaptvā makhairiṣṭvā kṛtvā dānānyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ ||
urvaśīṃ lokavikhyātāṃ rantukāmena bhūbhujā | prasādo bhavitā niyamurvaśyā me salokatā ||
vihāro bhavitā nityamiti kāmārṣaṇaṃ vyadhāt | labdhvācāpsarasāṃ mukhyamaramadbahuvatsaram ||
indreṇa bheditā veśyā tasyotkarṣāsahiṣṇunā | caraṇe nāhananmaulau purūsvasamurvaśī ||
na jātustraiṇasakhyāni santi sālāvṛkāssamṛtāḥ | rājānamapi kāmārtaṃ padā śīghramatāḍayat ||
papāta bhūtale svargādurvaśīcaraṇāhataḥ | bhūmau sthitvā parāmṛśya jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā ||
aśapatkrodhatāmrākṣasvarveṇyāṃ madagarvitām | he jāye mannasātiṣṭha iti proktammayāpurā ||
tvayā vimṛśya madvākyaṃ haṭhādindreṇa coditā | pādena tāḍito yasmāt bhage rogaḥ prajāyatām ||
ye veśīmupayāntyajñā vedaniṣṭhairbahiṣkṛtāḥ | bhaveyuḥ karmma vimukhā grandhilaśśūlarogiṇaḥ ||
apivā mātaraṃ gacchennagaccheddeva dārikām | mātṛkalpāṃ svaliṅgasya chedanammunibhissmṛtam ||
rūpā jīvāsunā satye niṣkṛtirmunibhiḥ smṛtā | iti śapte tāndevānśarajālena rāvaṇaḥ ||
viṣedurdevagandharvā dānavāścāraṇaissaha | rāmamārtantadā dṛṣṭvā tyaktvā tūṣṇīnnyavīviśan ||
vasiṣṭho nṛpaśāpena tyaktvā dehamacetanam | satyalokeśvaraṃ natvā punardehamayācata ||
vasiṣṭhena samājñaptaḥ kṣetraśuddhimathākarot | brahma diviṣadāṃ guptyai śāpaśuddhimatanvata ||
punarevoditaśśāpo hyapsarassu na duṣyati | mānuṣīṣu bhaveddoṣo rūpā jīvāsu kāmiṣṭha ||
parṇaśālāmathāgatya śūnyāṃ prekṣyātha rāghavaḥ | cakrośa sītāmudvīkṣya pakvatālaphalastanīm ||
bimboṣṭhīṃ kadalīkāṇḍajaṅghāṃ bilvopamastanīm | kāmāturāṇāṃ kāmyeṣu prītiritthaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
itthaṃ brahmaṇī cedvṛttistasya muktirbhaviṣyati | iti dyotayituṃ rāmo rurododdiśya gehinīm ||
sītāmanvekṣamāṇau tau dadṛśāte raṇakṣitau | kṣatajārdrammahākāyammumurṣuṃ pakṣipārthivam ||
dayāñcakāra śrīrāmo bhāryā rakṣaṇatoṣitaḥ | bāṇamokṣeṇa pāpānāṃ gṛdhraṃ dagdhumathaicchata ||

he rāma bhavatājñapto rakṣitā janakātmajā ||
daśagrīvo jahāraināṃ vaide lagne vimūḍhadhīḥ | hatvā pakṣau māmakau sa candrahāsena vīryavān ||
keśachāyāṃ parāmṛśya jānuchāyāṃ tathaiva ca | dakṣiṇādiśamākramya laṃkāyāṃ gatavānprabho ||
devīmāmāha rājendra yāvatsaṃbhāṣaṇammama | bhavatā tāvadāstāmme prāṇā ityāha jānakī ||
ityuktvā sa jahau prāṇānrādhavendrasya sannidhau | kaṅkācale samārādhya maheśaṃ labdhavānvaram ||
tasmātsvarūpaṃ gatavānraghunāthasya pakṣirāṭ | jayayossaṃskṛtiṃ śrutvā svarlokaṃ yātimānavaḥ ||
pluṣṭissañcitapāpānāṃ prārabdhānāṃ bhaviṣyati | dāhodyuktaṃ raghuvaraṃ prāha vāgaśarīriṇī ||
śmaśānarahite rāma kuru saṃskāramasya tu |
ityukto divyayā vāṇyā rāmassaumitriṇā saha ||
dagdhumudyogamāsthāya jaṭāyossamahītale | tatra cāpyaśarīrākhyā vāṇī provāca rāghavam ||
atra pūrvaṃ śatandagdhaṃ jaṭāyūnāṃ tvayā purā | ityuktaṃ kṣmātalaṃ sarvaṃ vilokya pitṛkānanam ||
vāmorau dāhamakarojjaṭāyormuktihetave | lakṣmī tadbhāgamutsṛjya gatā vakṣasthalaṃ hareḥ ||
dakṣiṇaṃ kaustubhākrāntaṃ rāghavendrasya sarvadā | vinā śrāddhaṃ samākarṇya pitarastṛptigāminaḥ ||
yajjātayo mṛtiṃ yāyāttajjātīyāṃśca pūjayet | brāhmaṇaḥ prathamaṃ pūjyajātīyāstadanantaram ||
rāmo nārāyaṇo devassītālakṣmīti kīrtitā | rāvaṇena parāmṛṣṭā keśādvedavatī vibho ||
sītāvedavatī deva daśagrīveṇa rakṣasā | śritavai kuṇṭhabhavanā pūrṇāṃśenāvatīrṇavān ||
lakṣmīḥ kutrasthitā deva hariṃ nityāśritā svayam | sītālakṣmyorbhidākantu abhedo vā vadasva me ||
bhede kutra sthitā lakṣmīrabhede dūṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu | kena bhūlokagamanaṃ bhavatritayasaṃbhavaḥ ||
kasmallaṅkānivāsaśca rākṣasīnāṃ ca tarjjanam |
haraṇaṃ rāvaṇenāpi kena viṣṇoḥ priyā bhavet |
